_meta.purpose: In-game behaviour confirmed by the user (Global version, duel betting / 对弈竞猜). Takes precedence over the wiki AI table (data/kb/ai.json, ~2019) when they disagree.

battle.replayDeterministic: Watching a round's replay twice shows the identical battle: each round has one fixed outcome.
battle.aiTargeting: Single-target choice usually looks random (community sources: lowest HP% below a per-shikigami threshold, otherwise random).

shikigami.282 Kingyo 金鱼姬: Casts skill 3 (金鱼·助阵) when onibi is enough AND the summon slot is free (no Goldfish).
shikigami.370 Mishige 饭笥: Usually skill 2. Skill 3 unlocks at 6 储备粮 stacks: highest-HP enemy 100%, then 8 random hits of 33%, consumes 4 stacks. At 10 stacks a free strong form auto-casts (180% highest-HP, 40% of it as TRUE damage split among others, 9 random hits of 33%, cleanses control first using 5 stacks, consumes all stacks).
shikigami.339 Blazing Tamamonomae 烬天玉藻前: Skill 3 random hits can hit the same enemy several times.
shikigami.562 Senhime Resurgent 鲸汐千姬: Illusion opens at battle start (L5 先机), so skill 3 costs 1 onibi on her turns; casts skill 3 whenever possible; never casts skill 2. 海凝: max 9 stacks, each stores up to 5000% of her initial ATK; 极昼鲸 (max 2) applies 158% ATK 海凝 to the 3 lowest-HP enemies and detonates 海凝 as indirect damage.
shikigami.344 Ungaikyo 云外镜: Never casts skill 2 (斗转). Only skill 3 or normal attack, in both Yin and Yang forms.
shikigami.593 Yoto Hime, Scarlet Nightedge 妖刀姬·绯夜猎: Casts skill 3 whenever onibi is enough. (Global name = UR 593 per fandom name_gl; earlier keyed as 328 赤影妖刀姬 = Global "Crimson Yoto".) User observation across many betting rounds: her side wins rarely (~1 in 10) and her damage does not look high. Bid records 11.19–11.23: her side won 3 of 10. Match #4 replay video: per-hit damage matches the sim (~1.0x); she counters (Scarlet Prelude) after ordinary damage about once per turn (~12 counters, ~60k, also under Hannya's barrier); 4 Midnight Hunts (1 free after a kill); she survived until Yato no Kami's wedge true damage. Her side's losses came from opposing mechanics the sim lacked (Yato wedges, Oitsuki 照君 stacks), not from her damage being overrated.
shikigami.306 Mushishi 虫师: Casts skill 3 only when an ally has low HP (wiki: ally below 70%); otherwise normal attack.
shikigami.372 Inaba Kaguya Hime 因幡辉夜姬: AI loop: skill 3 → skill 2 → skill 3 → skill 2 … (skill 2 also opens at battle start via Upper Hand). If she was controlled, her next action is always skill 2. This matches the KB rule (illusion left ≤ 1 → 愿满夜, otherwise 寂光映月), because a controlled turn still ticks the illusion down.
shikigami.220 Inugami 犬神: Casts skill 3 whenever onibi is enough (NOT the wiki's 50/50). At battle start marks 2 (sometimes 3) allies; damage to a marked ally triggers Inugami's counter on the attacker.
